description: In an AutoHide dock, moving the cursor outside while a right-click menu is open keeps the panel visible through the interaction lock.

assertions.comment: The first pinned launcher’s right-click menu remains open and provides Unpin, Settings, and Quit
assertions.pixel_exempt: The menu is built and its entries are read in-process, but Wayland only maps a popup for a real grabbing parent surface, so whether anything paints here is a race. Judged on the menu model, never on pixels.

assertions.comment: The unnamed panel path (0/0/2) remains fully visible while the menu is open even with the cursor outside
assertions.pixel_exempt: The menu is built and its entries are read in-process, but Wayland only maps a popup for a real grabbing parent surface, so whether anything paints here is a race. Judged on the menu model, never on pixels.

assertions.comment: While interaction is locked, the panel does not move to its hidden position and stays at visible position y=36
assertions.pixel_exempt: The menu is built and its entries are read in-process, but Wayland only maps a popup for a real grabbing parent surface, so whether anything paints here is a race. Judged on the menu model, never on pixels.
